findings.evidence: The declarations are at `ExteriorPower.lean:185` and `ClassicalGroups/ExteriorPower.lean:77`; Mathlib’s `exteriorPower.finrank_eq` at `Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/ExteriorPower/Basis.lean:159` already has assumptions `[Nontrivial R] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]`, not `Field R`.
findings.fix: Prove the generic theorem under `[CommRing R] [Nontrivial R] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]` using the exterior-power basis (or an empty `powersetCard` index), then move `extPowerRep_eq_zero_of_lt` into the `CommRing` section.
findings.issue: `exteriorPower.eq_zero_of_finrank_lt` assumes `Field R`, which makes the generic result and `extPowerRep_eq_zero_of_lt` unavailable over commutative rings where the exterior power still vanishes above finite free rank.

summary: The vanishing API is unnecessarily restricted to fields despite Mathlib’s exterior-power basis and finrank theorem working for finite free modules over nontrivial commutative rings.
